hook.name: DiminishingFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that overrides the LP fee on each swap. The contract contains logic to apply time-based diminishing fees (stepping down through configurable fee tiers as time elapses since pool initialization), but the afterInitialize callback that records the initialization timestamp is commented out in the deployed code. As a result, the hook always returns the initial fee tier (feeTiers[0]) for all pools.
